webui_enabled.hint: Allow AstrBot WebUI plugin views to access authenticated local management endpoints.

remote_menu_sync.hint: Allow confirmed managed QQ command panels to synchronize with stable local command catalogs.

profile_max_records.hint: Maximum number of cached group and member profile records.

profile_max_bytes.hint: Maximum byte budget for cached group and member profile records.

profile_stale_seconds.hint: Seconds before a cached profile is marked stale for refresh.

profile_cooldown_seconds.hint: Cooldown seconds after an upstream profile query failure or denial.
